reason: The official PostgreSQL Alpine image defines postgres as UID 70. It is non-root, drops all capabilities, cannot escalate privileges, and has no host mounts. An arbitrary high UID would require a separately maintained database image to preserve initdb passwd lookup compatibility.

The candidate is tested on an ephemeral Docker bridge with no published host ports and generated disposable credentials. HTTP-only remains informational in the report. This exception does not apply to public ingress, other URLs, or future external environments, which require TLS.
